spans.s: तप् (I) tad. affix त added to the words पर्वन् and मरुत् to form the words पर्वतः and मरुत्तः; cf.
; (2) personal end- ing in Vedic Literature substitut- cd for त of the impera. sec. pers. pl. e. g. श्रुणोत ग्रावाणः cf. Kas. on
तपरकरण addition of the mute letter त् after a vowel to signify the in- clusion of only such varieties of the vowel as take the same time for their utterance as the vowel marked with त्; cf.
